name: The Roman Empire under Trajan
blurb: Peak territorial extent, sound currency, superb civil engineering, an economy resting on slavery, and an elite that despises manual work.

institutions.note: No limited liability and no corporation. A societas dissolves on a partner's death. This is a real constraint on any enterprise meant to outlive you, and the workaround is a testamentary foundation endowed in land.

values._note: w_magic_fear 0.8 because the Lex Cornelia is used against malefici and astrologers are expelled repeatedly. w_religious_rigidity only 0.2 because Roman religion is pluralistic and absorbs new cults readily; it is MAGIC that is criminal, not heterodoxy. w_labour_saving negative because of the Vespasian precedent and cheap coerced labour.
values._note_eminence: An autocracy in which prominence is lethal: Sejanus, Seneca, Thrasea Paetus. The higher you rise the fewer people are above you, and every one of them is a threat.

notes: Slavery is the central economic institution and it suppresses the business case for every labour-saving device.
Manual work is socially degrading: Cicero De Officiis 1.150-151, Seneca Ep. 90.
Unlicensed associations are illegal: Trajan refuses Pliny even a fire brigade, Ep. 10.34.
Already trades annually to India on the monsoon and by relay to China.
